title: Running Commentary on Torah 60 — Pasach R' Shimon v'Amar
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 60 — פתח ר' שמעון ואמר
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

segments.beginner: When there are wars in the world, intellect requires there to be yakros (scarcity, high prices). For wars and bloodshed awaken the curse of Kayin: 'when you work the ground it shall not yield its strength to you' (Genesis 4:12) — through the bloodshed in the world. The curse was stated for shefichus damim, and the earth is liable in this when there is shefichus damim. Rains are made through the eidim — vapors — that rise from the earth: 've-ed ya'aleh min ha-aretz' (Genesis 2:6); from those eidim the rains are formed. When there are wars and shefichus damim, those very eidim become shefichus damim. As written: 'va-tagger es Bnei Yisrael al yedei cherev be-eis eidam' (Ezekiel 35:5–6) — bechinas the eidim through which shefichus damim is made. Likewise about Mitzrayim, Ammon, Moav: 'be-eis eidam' (Ezekiel 35:5 et al.). So when there is war, the earth gives its strength there — to bloodshed — for from her eidim is bloodshed made; therefore rain does not fall, since the eidim are diverted to another use. (Taanis 8b: 'in the time of rain even gisos cease' — when rains fall the gisos and wars cease.)
segments.intermediate: **K'she-yesh milchamos ba-olam, ha-sechel mechayev she-yiheyeh yakros** — ki **nis-orer kilelas Kayin: "כִּי תַעֲבֹד אֶת הָאֲדָמָה לֹא תֹסֵף תֵּת כֹּחָהּ לָךְ"** (בר' ד:יב) — al-yedei shefichus damim. Ki kelelah zos ne'emrah al shefichus damim, ki ha-adamah chayeves bazos k'she-yesh shefichus damim. Ki **ha-geshamim na'asin al-yedei ha-eidim ha-olim min ha-aretz** — "וְאֵד יַעֲלֶה מִן הָאָרֶץ" (בר' ב:ו). U-min ha-eidim ha-olim min ha-aretz mizeh na'asim geshamim. Ve-k'she-yesh milchamos ve-shefichus damim, az **na'aseh me-ha-eidim ha-na"l shefichus damim**: "וַתַּגֵּר אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל יְדֵי חֶרֶב בְּעֵת אֵידָם" (יח' לה:ה-ו) — bechinas eidim ha-na"l. Ve-chen be-kamah umos: Mitzrayim, Ammon, Mo'av — **"בְּעֵת אֵידָם"** (יח' לה:ה ve-shar) — bechinas eidim. Lachen k'she-yesh milchamos, ha-adamah nosenes kochah le-sham (la-shefichus damim), u-mi-menah ein yordim geshamim — ki ha-geshamim na'asim me-ha-eidim, ve-achshav na'aseh me-ha-eidim inyan acher: shefichus damim. (תענית ח: 'בשעת גשמים אפילו גיסות פוסקות בו') — k'she-yesh geshamim, nifsakim ha-gisos ve-ha-milchamos.
segments.scholarly: [T2:60a] מלחמות → יקרות. קללת קין: "לא תוסיף תת כוחה" (בר' ד:יב); "ואד יעלה" (בר' ב:ו). "בעת אידם" (יח' לה:ה-ו). תענית ח: "בשעת גשמים אפילו גיסות פוסקות".

segments.beginner: Connected to this is the gemara (Pesachim 112a): when R. Akiva was in tefisah, R. Shimon ben Yochai said to him, 'Rabbi, teach me Torah, and if not — I will tell Yochai my father, and he will hand you over la-malchus.' These are extremely astonishing words — that R. Shimon would speak this way to his rebbe, threatening to hand him over to the malchus. And presumably, when his rebbe R. Akiva did not want to teach him, he certainly intended for the good. And besides — was R. Akiva not already imprisoned? What further handing-over could there be?
segments.intermediate: **U-le-zeh mekasher mah she-amru chaza"l: "כשהיה רבי עקיבא בתפיסה אמר לו ר' שמעון בן יוחאי: רבי, למדני תורה, ואם לאו, אני אומר ליוחאי אבא ומוסרך למלכות"** (פסחים קיב.). **U-ve-vadai ha-devarim temuhim me'od me'od** she-RaShBY yomar ka-devarim ha-eilu le-rabo she-yim-serehu la-malchus. Ve-gam ki **mi-stama k'she-Rabi Akiva rabo lo ratzah le-lamdo, be-vadai kavan le-tovah**. Ve-gam ha-lo kvar hayah tafus ba-tefisah, u-mah yim-serehu od?
segments.scholarly: [T2:60b] פסחים קיב.: ר"ש בן יוחאי לר"ע — "למדני תורה ואם לאו אני אומר ליוחאי אבא ומוסרך למלכות". קושיות: לרבו? וכי לא היה כבר תפוס?

segments.beginner: But know: through one who says Torah be-rabim and listeners who are not hagun (worthy) hear, atziras geshamim also comes. For through kavod ha-Torah rains come — bechinas 've-chvod Hashem nir'ah ba-anan' (Exodus 16:10) — and through the anan come geshamim. Bechinas 'Kel ha-kavod hir'im, Hashem al mayim rabim' (Psalms 29:3) — geshamim that come through kavod Hashem, kavod ha-Torah. One who teaches Torah to a talmid she-eino hagun — chaza"l said (Chullin 133a) it is as if he throws a stone to Markulis. And Tosfos (Sanhedrin 64a, s.v. Markulis) explained Markulis = mar killus, master of disgrace — heipech ha-kavod. So when one teaches Torah to a talmid she-eino hagun, it is heipech ha-kavod, and through this comes atziras geshamim — heipech ha-kavod that brings rains. As Mishlei 26:1: 'ka-matar ba-katzir, ken lo na'aveh li-chsil kavod' — when one teaches Torah to a talmid she-eino hagun (= 'noten li-chsil kavod' — Chullin shem), one ruins the rains. 'Ka-matar ba-katzir' = ruined rains, falling out of season — at the harvest, rain harms; just so 'lo na'aveh li-chsil kavod,' for through that itself one ruins the rains.
segments.intermediate: **Ach da, ki gam al-yedei mi she-omer Torah be-rabim ve-shomim talmidim she-einan hagunim — al-yedei zeh ba gam-ken atziras geshamim.** Ki **al-yedei kvod ha-Torah ba geshamim** — bechinas "וּכְבוֹד ה' נִרְאָה בֶּעָנָן" (שמ' טז:י), ve-al-yedei ha-anan ba geshamim. Bechinas **"אֵל הַכָּבוֹד הִרְעִים, ה' עַל מַיִם רַבִּים"** (תה' כט:ג) — geshamim ha-ba'im al-yedei kvod Hashem, bechinas kvod ha-Torah. Ve-ha-lomed Torah le-talmid she-eino hagun amru chaza"l (חולין קלג.) **"כזורק אבן למרקוליס"**. U-fershu chaza"l (תוס' סנה' סד. ד"ה מרקולי"ס): **מ"ר קלו"ס** — heipech ha-kavod. Nimtza k'she-lomed Torah le-talmid she-eino hagun — heipech ha-kavod, ve-al-ken al-yedei zeh ba atziras geshamim — heipech ha-kavod she-al-yado ba'im geshamim. Ve-zehu bechinas **"כְּמַטָּר בַּקָּצִיר כֵּן לֹא נָאוֶה לִכְסִיל כָּבוֹד"** (משלי כו:א) — k'she-lomed Torah le-talmid she-eino hagun — bechinas "נותן לכסיל כבוד" — al-yedei zeh **mekalkel ha-geshamim**: "ka-matar ba-katzir" — ki-lekul ha-geshamim she-yordim she-lo bi-itan; **bi-she'as ha-katzir aderaba mazik ha-matar** — ken lo na'aveh li-chsil kavod, ki al-yedei zeh be-atzmo hu kilekul ha-geshamim.
segments.scholarly: [T2:60c] תורה ברבים לתלמיד שאינו הגון → היפך הכבוד → עצירת גשמים. "וכבוד ה' נראה בענן" (שמ' טז:י). "אל הכבוד הרעים" (תה' כט:ג). "כזורק אבן למרקוליס" (חולין קלג.); תוס' סנה' סד. — מר קלוס. "כמטר בקציר... לא נאוה לכסיל כבוד" (משלי כו:א).

segments.beginner: And this is what RaShBY said to R. Akiva — 'lamdeini Torah, ve-im lav, ani omer.' R. Akiva would gather kehilos and expound be-rabim, and RaShBY held that this was why he was caught in tefisah — because he expounded be-rabim and people who were not hagun heard. For through chiddushei Torah revealed, Elokus is drawn ki-vyachol: 'va-yikchu li terumah' (Exodus 25:2) — when you wish to take and draw Me, only through Torah; through the Torah He is drawn ki-vyachol. To where is the Elokus drawn? Into the moach of the listener. And although that is itself a kind of tefisah ki-vyachol — bechinas 'melech asur ba-rehatim' = berahatei mochin (Tikkunei Zohar end, Tikkun 6, 5a; see Tikkun 6, 21b), 'asur' precisely — that His Elokus yisborach is drawn berahatei mochin is bechinas tefisah, bechinas 'shavisa shevi' (Psalms 68:19) — nevertheless it is nicha to Hashem yisborach that He be drawn through the Torah, even though it is bechinas tefisah. But when one teaches Torah to a talmid she-eino hagun and draws His Elokus into that mind — zeh tefisah mamash, and therefore his onesh is tefisah. RaShBY thought that this is why R. Akiva was caught in tefisah; through the tefisah, the words he had introduced to talmidim she-einan hagunim would be rectified and refined — bechinas 've-atem he-as-ru ve-yibachanu divreichem' (Genesis 42:16). Therefore RaShBY said, 'lamdeini Torah,' so that by teaching him now, the previous flaw — that he had taught Torah to talmidim she-einan me-hugnam — would be repaired.
segments.intermediate: **Ve-zehu she-amar RaShBY le-Rabi Akiva: "לַמְּדֵנִי תּוֹרָה, וְאִם לָאו, אֲנִי אוֹמֵר"** וכו'. Ki Rabi Akiva hayah **makhil kehilos ve-doresh be-rabim**, ve-savar RaShBY she-mi-pnei zeh nispas ba-tefisah — me-chamas she-haya doresh be-rabim ve-shamu benei adam she-einam me-hugnam. Ki **al-yedei chiddushei Torah she-megalin nimshach Elokus ki-vyachol** — **"וְיִקְחוּ לִי תְּרוּמָה"** (שמ' כה:ב): k'she-tirzu likach u-le-hamshich osi, ee-efshar ki im al-yedei ha-Torah. U-le-heichan nimshach ha-Elokus? **Le-soch moach ha-shomea**. Ve-af she-zehu **tefisah ki-vyachol** — bechinas **"מֶלֶךְ אָסוּר בָּרְהָטִים"** (שיה"ש ז:ו) — **be-rahatei mochin** (סוף תיקוני זוה"ק תיקון ו' ה.; ת"ו כא:) — 'asur' dika, she-mah she-nim-shach Elokuso ki-vyachol berahatei mochin hu **bechinas tefisah**, bechinas **"שָׁבִיתָ שֶּׁבִי"** (תה' סח:יט) — af-al-pi-chen nicha la-Hashem yisborach she-yiheyeh nimshach al-yedei ha-Torah, af she-hu bechinas tefisah. **Aval k'she-lomed Torah le-talmid she-eino hagun u-mamshich Elokuso le-soch mocho — zos tefisah mamash, ve-al-ken oneshs tefisah.** Ve-al-ken savar RaShBY she-al-yedei zeh nispas Rabi Akiva ba-tefisah — ki **al-yedei ha-tefisah yis-takein ve-yiz-dakekhu ha-dibburim she-hichnis le-talmidim she-einan hagunim** — bechinas **"וְאַתֶּם הֵאָסְרוּ וְיִבָּחֲנוּ דִּבְרֵיכֶם"** (בר' מב:טז). Ve-al-ken amar RaShBY le-Rabi Akiva she-yi-lemdenu Torah, ve-al-yedei she-yi-lemad atah le-RaShBY — al-yedei zeh yi-takein ha-pgam ha-na"l, **she-lamad Torah le-talmidim she-einan me-hugnam**.
segments.scholarly: [T2:60d] "ויקחו לי תרומה" (שמ' כה:ב). "מלך אסור ברהטים" (שיה"ש ז:ו) — תיק"ז ת"ו ה. ו-כא:. "שבית שבי" (תה' סח:יט). תפיסה לתיקון הדיבורים: "ואתם האסרו ויבחנו דבריכם" (בר' מב:טז). למידת תורה לתלמיד שאינו הגון = תפיסה ממש.

segments.beginner: 'And if not — ani omer le-Yochai abba' — 'I will say' precisely: I will say Torah myself, in the bechinah of 'Yochai my father' — bechinas chasadim mi-tzad ha-av, the source of Torah-revelation, since giluy ha-Torah is giluy ha-chasadim (Kesuvos 96a: 'kol ha-monea talmido mi-le-shamsho — ke-ilu monea mimenu chesed' — Job 6:14). Each person has chasadim and gevuros: chasadim mi-tzad ha-av, etc. R. Akiva had no chasadim mi-tzad ha-av — he was ben gerim, lacking zechus avos (Berachos 27b: they did not appoint him nasi mi-shum de-leis lei zechus avos). RaShBY thought R. Akiva did not want to say Torah for this reason. But RaShBY had chasadim mi-tzad aviv R. Yochai (a great one in Israel — Hakdamas Zohar 11a, 'Yochai ha-bar-na'). Therefore RaShBY said: 've-im lav — ani omer le-Yochai abba' — I will say Torah, bechinas chasadim mi-tzad ha-av, source of giluy ha-Torah, giluy ha-chasadim. And 'u-mosrekha la-malchus' — Rabbi Shimon thought that R. Akiva's reluctance to say Torah and reveal the chasadim came only from his anvanus: in his humility R. Akiva thought he could not reveal Torah without chasadim mi-tzad ha-av and could only repair the pegam through tefisah (since tefisah is tikkun and zikkukh la-dibburim). But really R. Akiva is so great he has chasadim mi-tzad atzmo and does not need zechus avos at all — he can reveal Torah through chasadim mi-tzad atzmo and rectify the pegam thus. (The Rebbe did not explain how giluy ha-Torah revealing chasadim rectifies that flaw, nor how a talmid with zechus avos saying Torah forces his rebbe into gadlus and into saying Torah.)
segments.intermediate: **"וְאִם לָאו, אֲנִי אוֹמֵר" — 'אני אומר' דייקא** — RaShBY amar le-Rabi Akiva: im einecha rotzeh lelamdeni, **ani omer Torah**. Ve-zehu **"אני אומר ליוחאי אבא"** — ki **kol chiddushei Torah she-megalin — al-yedei zeh megalin chasadim** (כתוב' צו: 'כל המונע תלמידו מלשמשו, כאילו מונע ממנו חסד' — איוב ו:יד). Ve-yesh be-chol echad chasadim ve-gevuros — **chasadim mi-tzad ha-av** etc. **R. Akiva lo hayah lo chasadim mi-tzad ha-av** — ki **ben gerim** hayah, ve-lo hayah lo **zechus avos** (ברכות כז: she-lo banu le-manoso nasi 'di-leis leih zechus avos'). Ve-savar RaShBY she-Rabi Akiva eino rotzeh lomar Torah me-chamas zeh — she-ein lo chasadim mi-tzad ha-av. **Aval RaShBY hayah lo chasadim mi-tzad aviv R. Yochai** (gadol be-Yisrael — הקדמת זוה"ק יא. "יוחאי הברנא"). Ve-al-ken amar RaShBY: 've-im lav — ani omer le-Yochai abba' — **she-ani omer Torah she-hi bechinas "Yochai abba" — bechinas chasadim mi-tzad ha-av** she-misham hisgalus ha-Torah, ki hisgalus ha-Torah = hisgalus ha-chasadim. **Ve-zehu "ומוסרך למלכות"** — RaShBY savar she-zos she-Rabi Akiva eino rotzeh lomar Torah u-le-galos ha-chasadim, **rak me-chamas anvanuso** shel R. Akiva (anav hu, sover she-eino yachol legalos Torah me-chamas she-ein lo chasadim mi-tzad ha-av; eino yachol le-takkein ha-pgam ela al-yedei tefisah — she-ha-tefisah tikun ve-zikkukh la-dibburim). **Aval be-emes Rabi Akiva rabbi gadol ka-zeh she-yesh lo chasadim mi-tzad atzmo, ve-eino tzarich le-zechus avos klal**, ve-yachol R. Akiva legalos Torah al-yedei ha-chasadim she-yesh lo mi-tzad atzmo levad — ve-al-yedei zeh yi-takein ha-pgam. (**Ve-lo bei'er** eich al-yedei hisgalus ha-Torah ha-megalin chasadim al-yedei zeh yi-takein ha-pgam; ve-gam lo bei'er eich al-yedei ha-talmid she-yesh lo zechus avos k'she-megaleh Torah — al-yedei zeh yih-yeh rabo mukhrach lavo bi-gdulah ve-lomar Torah).
segments.scholarly: [T2:60e] גילוי תורה = גילוי חסדים. כתובות צו.: "כל המונע תלמידו מלשמשו כאילו מונע חסד"; איוב ו:יד. ר"ע בן גרים — ברכות כז:; אין זכות אבות. רשב"י — "יוחאי הברנא"; הקדמת זוה"ק יא.. סברת רשב"י: ר"ע ענו, וצריך להביאו בעל-כרחו לגדלות. (הערה: הרבי לא ביאר המנגנון המלא).

segments.beginner: And this is 'u-mosrekha la-malchus' — 'mesirah' is a lashon of be-al-korcho ('va-yim-saru me-alfei Yisrael' — Numbers 31:5; Rashi: she-nim-seru be-al-korcham). RaShBY will bring R. Akiva be-al-korcho into the bechinah of gadlus through his own (RaShBY's) saying Torah — and R. Akiva will be compelled to come into gadlus and say Torah, which is hisgalus ha-chasadim, the tikkun of the pegam. By RaShBY the talmid revealing Torah from chasadim mi-tzad ha-av, R. Akiva will be brought to the bechinah of gadlus be-al-korcho until he is compelled to say Torah himself.
segments.intermediate: **Ve-zehu "ומוסרך למלכות"** — **mesirah lashon be-al-korcho**, ke-mo she-katuv **"וַיִּמָּסְרוּ מֵאַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל"** (במ' לא:ה) — peresh Rashi: 'she-nim-seru be-al-korcham'. Ki **RaShBY yavi et Rabi Akiva be-al-korcho li-vchinas gadlus al-yedei she-hu yomar Torah** — ad she-yikrach R. Akiva be-al-korcho lavo bi-gdulah ve-lomar Torah — she-hi **hisgalus ha-chasadim** — tikkun ha-pgam ha-na"l.
segments.scholarly: [T2:60f] מסירה = בעל-כרחו. "וימסרו מאלפי ישראל" (במ' לא:ה); רש"י שם. תלמיד עם זכות אבות מגלה תורה → רבו מוכרח לגדלות → גילוי חסדים → תיקון פגם הלימוד לתלמידים שאינם מהוגנים.
